# The golem's glowing cracks (generated by make_env.py): zigzag bars of light standing 6 cm off the
# urn's and the head's front flats, in the golem's frame (hedra: up Z, facing -Y). Origin on the ground.
new
material new Crack --base-color 0.3412 0.6235 0.7059 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Crack0 --size 1 --location -0.375 -0.449 1.555
scale 0.234 0.07 0.06
apply --scale
set rotation 0 45.0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Crack
